requirements.text: The pipeline shall ingest an MLDS scene and preserve stable object identities.
The pipeline shall derive room semantics grounded in existing MLDS objects.
The pipeline shall synthesize backend-compatible spatial agent roles.
Every generated agent knowledge tag shall be covered by materialized knowledge.
Every generated agent shall be placed inside the room without obstacle overlap.
The generated behavior shall be traceable from requirements to runtime actions and validation cases.

scenarios.description: Authoring pipeline for generating and validating a spatially grounded multi-agent room guide.

steps.text: Provide an MLDS file as case-study input.
Load and normalize the MLDS scene.
Derive semantic zones, visitor goals and interaction topics.
Generate spatially grounded agent roles and handoff rules.
Generate materialized knowledge entries for all agent knowledge tags.
Place generated agents inside the room near their responsibilities.
Assemble and validate the FunctionalMLDS trace instance.
Materialize the Interactive Agents project files.
Set up an Interactive Agents runtime session.

actors.name: Case Study Engineer
actors.description: Provides MLDS input and runs the validation pipeline.

actors.name: Visitor
actors.description: Asks room-related questions in the generated immersive environment.

actors.name: Room Guide
actors.description: Role played by generated interactive agents.

entities.name: Reception and Welcome Area
entities.purpose: Initial visitor greeting and orientation with branding and basic info.

entities.name: Product Showcase Area
entities.purpose: Display and demonstration of company products and technologies to attract interest.

entities.name: Company Benefits Information Zone
entities.purpose: Provide detailed information about employee benefits and company values via panels and interactive terminals.

entities.name: Recruiting and Job Application Area
entities.purpose: Interactive terminals and posters for job listings and application processes, with seating for discussions.

entities.name: Demo Kiosk Interaction Zone
entities.purpose: Interactive kiosks for product demos or company information accessible via touchscreen interfaces.

entities.name: Refreshment and Lounge Area
entities.purpose: Area for visitors to relax, have refreshments, and informal conversations.

agents.persona: Friendly and welcoming guide who provides initial orientation and basic company information to visitors, helping them navigate the booth efficiently.
Knowledgeable and approachable specialist focused on explaining employee benefits and company culture, assisting visitors with interactive terminals and panels.
Professional and helpful recruiting expert who assists visitors with job applications, provides detailed recruiting information, and answers related questions.
Enthusiastic and tech-savvy specialist who manages product showcases and VR/AR stations, guiding visitors through interactive demos and answering technical questions.
Warm and attentive hospitality professional dedicated to providing refreshments and ensuring visitor comfort in the lounge area.

events.expression: visitor question belongs to another agent expertise

conditions.expression: at least two valid agents exist
handoff target exists and is not the source agent

stateAssertions.expression: Normalized MLDS scene is valid and object IDs are unique.
Scene semantics are grounded in existing object IDs.
Generated agents have valid zones, objects, knowledge tags and handoff targets.
Every agent knowledge tag has at least one materialized knowledge entry.
Every generated agent has a valid room position and forward vector.
FunctionalMLDS instance satisfies all core invariants.
Interactive Agents project files are present and backend-readable.
Interactive Agents backend setup returns a valid session with all agents.
A visitor question is answered using room-grounded agent knowledge.
A specialist handoff targets an existing responsible agent when needed.

capabilities.text: Analyze MLDS scene structure and normalize room objects.

capabilities.text: Generate local knowledge entries for all agent knowledge tags.

capabilities.text: Place agents in valid positions near their responsible zones.
